{{Quote|Tatooine – city of Bestine: The capital of Tatooine is rife with corruption and political turmoil, and is also a key Imperial outpost. If we take and hold this city we will control a wealth of information that moves through the galactic underworld.|[[Ysanne Isard]], [[Imperial Naval Communiqué 31756]]|<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1043532|text=Star Wars Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15)}}</ref>}}
The '''Invasion of Bestine''' was a series of ongoing [[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege|sieges]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These sieges took place sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], but before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The plan to invade Bestine and other cities throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was concocted by the Rebel Alliance, but was intercepted by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], allowing for the Empire to prepare a proper defense. The invasion culminated in a series of violent sieges between the two factions, resulting in a back and forth occupation of the capital throughout the Galactic Civil War.
